about_the_game:
Brutal Brawls in the Wild West

Brawlers of the West is a physics-based Western brawler built around brutal, realistic melee combat and chaotic close-quarters fights in the lawless frontier. Every punch, kick, and throw is driven by physics, creating raw, unpredictable brawls where positioning, timing, and environmental awareness decide who stays standing.

Fight in dusty saloons where survival depends on your ability to adapt, improvise, and dominate your opponents at arm’s length.

Physics-Driven Melee Combat

Experience hard-hitting hand-to-hand combat powered by a dynamic ragdoll physics system. Every strike has weight and consequence — enemies stagger, lose balance, slam into objects, or collapse under powerful blows.

Combat rewards precision and awareness. A single well-timed punch, shove, or grapple can turn the tide of a fight, while reckless movement leaves you exposed.

Use the Environment as a Weapon

The environment is part of the fight.

Grab bottles, smash chairs, and use your surroundings to gain the upper hand. Every arena supports emergent, physics-based gameplay, enabling creative, brutal takedowns and improvised combat moments.

No two fights ever play out the same.

Diverse Fighters and Playstyles

Choose from a roster of fighters with distinct strengths and attributes. Whether you favor endurance, raw power, or relentless aggression, each character encourages a different approach to combat and battlefield control.

Master your fighter’s strengths to survive increasingly dangerous encounters.

Multiple Game Modes

Team Mayhem – Four teams of two battle until only one team remains.

Survival – Endure relentless enemy waves and push your limits.

Boss of the Saloon – Face powerful opponents in intense one-on-one showdowns.

Each mode challenges your combat skills in a different way.

Key Features

  • Physics-based melee combat with weighty, impactful hits

  • Ragdoll reactions that create dynamic and chaotic fights

  • Environmental interaction and improvised weapons

  • Gritty Western atmosphere and violent brawls

  • Multiple game modes with escalating challenge

Why Play Brawlers of the West

Every fight is brutal, physical, and unpredictable. Physics-driven combat creates raw brawls where timing, positioning, and aggression decide who stays standing.

Use the environment, overpower your enemies, and survive the lawless frontier. Wishlist now to follow development and be ready for the full release.
